title: ORI engineers active lysozymes, heat-tolerant chitinases and dual-activity enzymes
summary: Tencent researchers used ontology-conditioned generation and experimental feedback to engineer enzymes. In the reported assays, lysozyme TX-RL15 exceeded the earlier TX-L6 design by 66-fold and hen egg-white lysozyme by over two orders of magnitude. Chitinase TX-SC2 retained activity after incubation at 85 °C; selected proteins combined lysozyme and chitinase activity. These are bounded biochemical results. The date represents initial journal publication; the version of record followed on May 7, 2026.
ai_technology: ORI; protein generation model (PGM); unified sequence model (USM)
organization: Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab

evidence.tested: Expression, enzyme-activity and heat-treatment assays on selected generated proteins.
evidence.unknown: Separate supplements and independent replication not assessed. Assay-specific advantages do not establish industrial or clinical outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: Ontology-conditioned generation and reinforcement learning from experimental feedback.
